definition_zh: 将耦合更新过程分解为若干子算子求解的方法。
usage_overview: 用于材料本构计算中的状态更新。在考虑混凝土疲劳损伤的列车—轨道长期演化模型中，将更新过程分为弹性预测、塑性修正和损伤修正，逐步处理材料状态的变化。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: First, a spatial elastoplastic fatigue damage constitutive is introduced into the modelling of the vehicle-track interaction, and a nu merical scheme based on the operator split method is employed to update the stress state and internal variables of track structure.

In the numerical calculation of the elastoplastic damage constitutive model, an operator split method is widely recognized as effective [65–66], which algorithm includes three steps, elastic trial, plastic-corrector and damage-corrector step.
